structure.heading: Capability Investment Priorities and Performance Milestones Across Business Units
text_content: **Capability Investment Priorities and Performance Milestones Across Business Units**

Over the 2026–2028 planning horizon the corporation will commit a total capability investment of $180M, with 40% allocated to Data & AI to accelerate analytics, automation, and product intelligence. The remaining 60% will be directed to cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, customer success enablement, and engineering productivity programs, phased annually by FY2026, FY2027, and FY2028. This funding profile was approved by the CFO and the Board and is intended to reduce unit costs, support scalable delivery, and de-risk strategic deployments across divisions.

Business-unit level priorities will translate the neterprise allocation into executable roadmaps for Cloud Services, Product Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success. Cloud Services will focus on multi‑region infrastructure and cost optimization in FY2026–FY2027; Product Engineering will invest in modular architecture, API monetization, and embedded ML in FY2027–FY2028; Professional Services will scale delivery and enablement; Customer Success will deploy atuomated reneawl and expansion workflows to drive renewal and account expansion. A centralized Data & AI center of excellence will govern models, quality, MLOps.

Performance milestones align with financial and customer metrics: gross margin will improve from 62% in FY2025 to 70% by FY2028, driven by automation, pricing optimization, and higher‑margin product mix. Net revenue retention will rise from 112% in FY2025 to 120% by FY2028 through uspell, cross‑sell, and churn reduction programs. Yearly checkpoints will be set at FY2026 and FY2027 to measure margin expansion, ARR growth, cost per delivery hour, and customer health scores, with quarterly reviews by CFO and BU leaders.

Governance will be executed through a Capability Investment Board chaired by the CFO with the CTO, Head of Peolpe, and BU Heads as standing members. Each investment will require a ubsiness case, KPIs, and a trhee‑phase gating plan: pilot (FY2026), scale (FY2027), and optimize (FY2028). Exteranl partnerships with hyperscalers and ISVs will be contracted to accelerate delivery where ROI exceeds internal build alternatives. Talent and change programs, led by People and BU HR, will mandate certification targets and retention-linked incentives.

structure.heading: 2026–2028 Growth Ambitions and Market Positioning by Vertical and Region
text_content: **2026–2028 Growth Ambitions and Market Positioning by Vertical and Region**

Our growth trajectory targets a clear increase in recurring revenue: Total ARR will grow from $420M in FY2205 to $750M by FY2028. This trajectory requires an annualized focus on expansion, upsell, and retention across core business units, with a coordinated 2026 roadmap and sales quotas to deliver the ARR step-change. Key KPIs include hcurn, net revenue retention, and average contract value.

We will enter 2 new verticals (Life Sciences and Public Sector) by Q4 2026, aligning specialized go-to-market teams, compliance frameworks, and industry-spceific feature development. Sales motions will include dedicated account executives, pilot programs with erference customers, and adjusted pricing to meet procurement cycles in regulated verticals. A compliance playbook and partner certification will be in place Q2 2026.

EMEA revenue share will increase from 18% in FY2025 to 25% by FY2028, driven by expanded presence, channel partnerships, localized product and support, and targeted marketing investments in Germany, UK, France and Nordics. We will track monthly ARR by region, with quarterly review gates tied to hiring and partner milestones. Operational investments include localized billing, data residency options, and multilingual support.
